Name: SVE Claire Seasonal Anime Outfits
Author: DonutSteelPeas
Description:
I loved BunBunz's Anime interpretation of Claire from SVE who I was always interested in but lacked the Ohodavi's anime style I grown accustomed to in my game. Afterward I decided to use the Seasonal Portraits mod on top of it and realized in order for my game to be cohesive I'd have to work on providing Seasonal anime variants myself and not many other people had yet, so here's my Claire! I'm by no means an artist so hopefully you can overlook my work if it's shoddy, just wanted to make something satisfactory to me and hope you'll enjoy it as well!

Deserved Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/185039619]bunzbunzMODS[/url] for the Base Portrait used, please check out their mod at:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17516](SVE) Anime Portraits Replacer at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
P.S. If you're not okay with this release please dm me and I'll take it down ASAP!

How to Install:
First install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]
Next: Simply just replace the folder containing Claire's Portrait's with my own! (If on vortex you must empty Claire's folder on Seasonal Outfits - Slight Cuter Aesthetic for SVE out, DEPLOY, then put portraits in, REDEPLOY)

Downloads.Description: Take these files and move them into Seasonal Outfits for SVE's assets -> Potraits -> Claire, replacing the portraits originally from there.
